mapper.select: SELECT emp21_un_leave_cd AS un_leave_code , f_cdnm('unLeaveCode', emp21_un_leave_cd, emp21_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS un_leave_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp21_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_emptrans(emp21_person_id, emp21_start_date::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name , COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) AS hire_date , apr01.apr01_reg_date AS notice_date , sys01_leave_compulsion_rt AS duty_rt , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('01','02') THEN f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '1') - INTERVAL '1 years' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date) WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month' END::date AS leave_occur_start_date , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('01','02') THEN f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '1 years' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month -1day' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+12month -1day' END::date AS leave_occur_close_date , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('01','02') THEN f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '1') WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('03','04') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+1month' WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('05','06') THEN date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+10month' END::date AS leave_target_start_date , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd IN ('01','02') THEN f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') ELSE date_trunc('month', COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc, emp01_hire_date)) + interval '+12month -1day' END::date AS leave_target_close_date , emp21_total_days AS total_days , emp21_use_days AS use_days , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '5 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '1 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') END AS month01 , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '4 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2'), 'YYYY년 MM월') END AS month02 , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '3 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE '' END AS month03 , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '2 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE '' END AS month04 , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2') - INTERVAL '1 months', 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE '' END AS month05 , CASE WHEN emp21_un_leave_cd = '01' THEN to_char(f_get_close_date(#{companyId}, #{stdYear}, '2'), 'YYYY년 MM월') ELSE '' END AS month06 , sys01_company_nm AS company_name FROM emp21_un_leave INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp21_person_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp21_company_id INNER JOIN apr01_appr apr01 ON apr01.apr01_appr_id = emp21_appr_id WHERE emp21_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp21_un_leave_id = #{unLeaveId}

SELECT emp50_date AS date , emp50_start_point AS start_point , emp50_close_point AS close_point , emp50_start_time AS start_time , emp50_close_time AS close_time , emp50_amt AS amt , f_cdnm('TransportCode', emp50_transport_cd, emp50_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS transport_name , emp50_note AS note , f_get_empTrans(emp50_person_id, f_sysdate()::date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp50_person_id) AS person_name FROM emp50_transport_expense WHERE emp50_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp50_person_id = #{personId} AND emp50_transport_expense_id = #{transportExpenseId}

SELECT f_cdnm('BizTripCode', emp53_biz_trip_cd, emp53_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS biz_trip_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp53_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_empTrans(emp53_person_id, emp53_start_date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name , emp53_num AS num , emp53_companion AS companion , emp53_destination AS destination , emp53_start_date AS start_date , emp53_close_date AS close_date , emp53_purpose AS purpose FROM emp53_biz_trip WHERE emp53_biz_trip_id = #{bizTripId} AND emp53_company_id = #{companyId}
